input: Search commands, branches, files or repositories

ask.hint: Describe what Git should do, then press Enter. You see the plan first; nothing runs before you confirm it.

plan.undoHint: {{mod}}+Z brings back the local state before step 1 – for 14 days; pushed refs stay pushed.
plan.empty: No allowed step fits this request.
plan.blocked: An operation is in progress. Finish or abort it first.
plan.blockedStep: Step {{n}} can’t run as it is. Edit it (E) or remove it (Del).
plan.confirmFirst: Step {{n}} goes out to the remote. Confirm it with Space first.
plan.noArgs: This step has nothing to edit.
plan.tooLong: Plan too long – at most 10 steps. Ask for less at once.
plan.expired: The repository changed since the plan was shown. The plan has expired – ask again.
plan.stopped: The plan stopped at step {{n}}. The steps before it are done; {{mod}}+Z takes them back.
plan.cancelled: Cancelled. The steps already done stay done; {{mod}}+Z takes them back.

step.branchCreateCheckout: Create branch “{{name}}” at {{start}} and check it out
step.branchDeleteForce: Delete branch “{{name}}”, even if not merged

placeholder.commits: Search commits by message, author or SHA …
placeholder.all: Search commands, branches, files and repositories

empty.noRepoFiles: Files are only available in a repository tab. Open one with “~” or Alt+O.
empty.noRepoCommits: Commits are only available in a repository tab. Open one with “~” or Alt+O.
empty.noRepoBranches: Branches and tags are only available in a repository tab. Open one with “~” or Alt+O.
empty.commitsHint: Type a word from the message, an author or the first characters of a SHA.
empty.tryPrefix: Try fewer letters – or narrow it down with a prefix: “>” commands, “@” branches, “/” files, “#” commits.
empty.noRepos: No repository added yet. Open one with Alt+O.

failure.files: The file list could not be read.
failure.branches: The branches could not be read.

ff.upToDate: already up to date with the upstream
ff.ownCommits_one: {{count}} own commit in the way – pull or rebase
ff.ownCommits_other: {{count}} own commits in the way – pull or rebase
ff.otherWorktree: checked out in another worktree – pull there
ff.title: Fast-forward to “{{upstream}}”

reason.loading: The repository state is still being read
reason.openWip: Open the local changes first (WIP row in the graph)
reason.noOperation: No merge, rebase or cherry-pick is running
reason.oneRemote: There is only one remote – fetch is enough
reason.unborn: The repository has no commit yet
reason.selectTwo: Select exactly two commits in the graph
reason.selectRange: Select several consecutive commits in the graph
reason.selectCommit: Select a commit in the graph first
reason.selectOne: Only with exactly one selected commit
reason.notOnlyBehind: The branch is not only behind its upstream
reason.noTag: This repository has no tag yet
